panel.title: Minecraft Bridge
panel.subtitle: Manage the connection between N.E.K.O and TouhouLittleMaid.
connection.title: Connection Status
connection.pluginNotEnabledHint: The plugin has not started yet. Please enable this plugin in N.E.K.O, then click the refresh button to reload.
connection.portHelp: Change the port this plugin uses to connect to the Minecraft-side WebSocket. It must match the in-game N.E.K.O bridge config.
companion.title: Companion Activity
companion.description: Switch this plugin's proactive companion speech frequency.
companion.modeSummary.quiet: Quiet: waits longer before companion speech and uses longer speech/suggestion cooldowns.
companion.modeSummary.standard: Standard: the default balanced companion speech frequency.
companion.modeSummary.active: Active: allows companion speech sooner and uses shorter speech/suggestion cooldowns.
companion.modeSummary.custom: Custom: manually tune only the three proactive companion speech trigger/cooldown values.
companion.customHint: Custom settings only affect proactive companion speech frequency. Awareness polling, debouncing, aggregation, and anti-spam throttling are separate engineering parameters.
companion.fields.quietStableSecondsHelp: How long things must stay quiet before companion speech can trigger.
companion.fields.quietCooldownHelp: Minimum interval between idle-state proactive messages.
companion.fields.suggestionCooldownHelp: Minimum interval between proactive suggestion messages.
diagnostic.title: Bridge Diagnostic Result
plan.title: Current Goal Board
plan.emptyDescription: Set the current Minecraft session goal here and sync it to the in-game HUD.
plan.fields.title: Goal Title
command.title: Command Execution
command.enabled: Command execution enabled — AI can request Minecraft commands, player confirmation required in-game
command.disabled: Command execution not enabled — Enable "Command Execution" in the N.E.K.O bridge config screen in-game
command.description: When enabled, AI can request to execute Minecraft server commands (e.g. /time set day), but players must click the confirmation button in-game before execution.
maid.title: Assigned Maid
maid.notAssigned: No maid assigned. Please select a maid below.
maid.name: Name
maid.selectHint: Select a maid from the dropdown, then click the button to assign.
maid.noMaidsHint: No maids detected in the game. Make sure TouhouLittleMaid mod is installed and maids exist in the world.
maid.connectFirstHint: Connect to Minecraft first before assigning a maid.
entries.setPlanBoard.name: Update Goal Board
